title: SAE’s Nicomachean Ethics
intro: This is not an ethics written by SAE to complete Aristotle’s. It is thirteen local paired readings: from friends and truth, self-sufficiency, happiness and character, through responsibility, practical wisdom, acting against one’s knowledge, friendship and formation, to the final step from argument toward law and politics.

Each essay first reads a specific passage of the Nicomachean Ethics closely, then asks where it meets SAE and where they part, and finally lets Aristotle point back to the column SAE has not yet written. The simplified Chinese preserves the original voice with factual and verbal corrections only; traditional Chinese is an edited version on the same page.
source_note: SAE’s Nicomachean Ethics · SAE in Dialogue with Western Philosophy. Complete English translation checked against the Chinese essays. References follow the conventional book and chapter divisions and Bekker pagination.
